window: requests filed 2025-01-01 to 2026-10-13 (311 CSV, cleaned copy build/csb-clean), one row per distinct REQUESTID

definition.scored: promise date (PRJCOMPLETEDATE) on or before 2026-10-13 00:33 and status not CANCEL
definition.done_kept: kept, and the closing words are classed "done" by N2 (research/chapters/N2-closure-classes.csv)

citystat.counts_rule: mean absolute difference between our request count and CityStat's, 2024 Q1 to 2026 Q1, within 0.2% (rounded to a tenth of a percent)
citystat.counts_derivation: Computed by N6 from N4's quarter-by-quarter table (build/N4/citystat_comparison.csv): for each of CityStat's nine 311-based on-time measures, our request count under definition C (one row per request number, closed requests, by quarter filed) against the count in CityStat's own chart tables (Tableau summary data extracted 13 Oct 2026), averaged over the nine settled quarters 2024 Q1 to 2026 Q1.
citystat.lead_line: A weekly run would have shown this in July.
